news.headline: Four Saints defenders sat out Thursday practice
news.summary: Linebackers Kaden Elliss and Pete Werner and pass rushers Carl Granderson and Anfernee Jennings did not practice on Thursday. The Saints do not play until Monday night, so they have extra days to get healthy.

news.headline: Travis Etienne goes on injured reserve
news.summary: The Saints moved Travis Etienne to injured reserve on Thursday because of his hurt hamstring, so he will be out for a while. They signed running back Ulysses Bentley IV to the practice squad, and Alvin Kamara will do most of the running.

news.headline: Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller take over the running
news.summary: Travis Etienne is out for at least four games, so coach Kellen Moore said Kamara and Kendre Miller will split most of the carries. “I think Alvin and Kendre will handle that load really well,” Moore said.

news.headline: Two Florida receivers are questionable for Saturday
news.summary: Vernell Brown III has a mild knee strain and Bailey Stockton has a sore back, and both are listed as questionable at Missouri. Coach Jon Sumrall said neither injury is serious.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh wins the top offensive award in the SEC
news.summary: The conference named Baugh its offensive player of the week after he ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns against Ole Miss. Two more Gators were honored: London Montgomery on special teams and Bryce Lovett on the offensive line.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is expected to play at Missouri
news.summary: Tests on the knee Brown hurt Saturday came back clean, and coach Jon Sumrall said the news was great and he could be back this week. Eric Singleton, who missed two games with a sprained ankle, will practice fully.

news.headline: Landen Clark is likely to start for LSU on Saturday
news.summary: Sam Leavitt hurt his hamstring against Texas A&M and is not expected to play against McNeese. Coach Lane Kiffin has not named a starter, so backup Landen Clark should get the job.

news.headline: Trey'Dez Green hopes to play again on November 7
news.summary: The tight end hurt his knee against Ole Miss and does not need surgery. He is aiming to come back for the Alabama game in Baton Rouge on November 7.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt hurt his hamstring and may sit Saturday
news.summary: LSU's quarterback tweaked his left hamstring in Saturday's win over Texas A&M. Coach Lane Kiffin said he will be extremely cautious this week and has not decided whether Leavitt plays against McNeese.

nextGame.note: Tulane has a bye this coming Saturday.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.
